superadmin_firebase.title: Push Notifications (FCM)
superadmin_firebase.subtitle: One Firebase project serves the whole platform. Waiter apps receive notifications; delivery is routed per restaurant automatically.
superadmin_firebase.upload_hint: Firebase console → Project ការកំណត់ → Service accounts → Generate new private key. Do NOT use google-services.json (that belongs in the mobile app).
superadmin_firebase.delete_body: The stored service account will be removed and push notifications will stop for all restaurants. Device tokens are kept, so uploading a new key restores notifications without any app changes.
superadmin_firebase.invalid_json_file: That file is not valid JSON.
superadmin_firebase.pick_file_first: Upload a service account JSON file first.
superadmin_firebase.save_failed: Could not រក្សាទុក configuration.

superadmin_firebase.step_1_desc: Go to Firebase Console and select your project.
superadmin_firebase.step_2_title: Project ការកំណត់ & Service Accounts
superadmin_firebase.step_2_desc: Click ⚙️ Project ការកំណត់ and navigate to the Service accounts tab.
superadmin_firebase.step_3_desc: Click Generate new private key to download your Service Account JSON file.
superadmin_firebase.step_4_title: Upload and រក្សាទុក
superadmin_firebase.step_4_desc: Upload the JSON file into the field on the left and click រក្សាទុក.
superadmin_firebase.warning_google_login: Turning off notifications will also turn off Google Sign-In.

superadmin_image_storage.step_1_desc: Choose between local server disk or an S3-compatible cloud provider (AWS S3, Cloudflare R2, DigitalOcean Spaces).
superadmin_image_storage.step_2_desc: For cloud storage, generate your Access Key ID, Secret Access Key, Bucket ឈ្មោះ, and Endpoint URL.

superadmin_google.title: Google Authentication
superadmin_google.subtitle: Configure Firebase credentials and control Google Sign-In availability for business ចូលប្រព័ន្ធ and registration.
superadmin_google.api_credentials_desc: Obtain these credentials from your Google Cloud Console project.
superadmin_google.save_settings: រក្សាទុក ការកំណត់
superadmin_google.step_1_desc: Go to Firebase Console and select your project (បង្កើត your project).
superadmin_google.step_2_title: Project ការកំណត់
superadmin_google.step_2_desc: Click the ⚙️ Project ការកំណត់ icon next to Project Overview and stay on the General tab.
superadmin_google.step_3_desc: Scroll down to Your apps, click បន្ថែម app (</> Web), enter a nickname, and click Register app.
superadmin_google.step_4_desc: Firebase will display the SDK config object. Copy the values into the fields on the left and រក្សាទុក.
superadmin_google.step_5_title: Upload Service Account JSON (On This ផ្ទាំងព័ត៌មាន)
superadmin_google.step_5_desc: Here in this admin ផ្ទាំងព័ត៌មាន website, go to Platform ការកំណត់ → Push Notifications and upload your downloaded Service Account JSON file.
superadmin_google.enable_body: On enabling, businesses can log in through Google and អ៊ីមែល.
superadmin_google.disable_body: On disabling, businesses can only log in through អ៊ីមែល and ពាក្យសម្ងាត់.
